Travel Kit

Version 1.3.0

Five Everyday Cool travel tools in one app: Tonight's Sky for the night above you, Find It for what you need wherever you are, Weather Everywhere for the whole planet's weather, The Radio Room for radio from everywhere, and The Survival Guide for putting it all together outdoors.

Built by Steven Powell with the Council. Tonight's Sky, the Weather Everywhere workshop, and The Survival Guide run offline; Find It and The Radio Room use live data when you are online, and links that leave the app open in your default browser.

Part of the Everyday Cool collection: caeled.github.io/everyday-cool
